decisions.reason: Although the portal is distant from the core display business, it has been publicly launched and resources committed, so escalation pressure keeps it in place for now, though exit is more plausible than for the core products.
The packaging display won a public award and builds on the established offer, creating strong sunk-cost and reputation-based commitment that makes withdrawal very unlikely.
As a close extension with its own public page, the firm has committed visibly and sunk costs are already incurred, so persistence is likely.
The counter display is close to the established business and has received a dedicated page, reinforcing public commitment and making withdrawal unlikely.
The freestanding information display is close to the core offer and publicly presented, so sunk costs and public commitment support keeping it.
